text: {"assertions":["A 401 storm bug in services/auth/token_refresh.py was caused by comparing a naive datetime against an aware datetime.","The bug manifested as bursts of unauthorized responses in the access log when access tokens expired mid-session.","The bug only affected accounts within the five percent rollout bucket.","The fix involved making all datetime boundaries timezone-aware at the edge via PR #2262 on branch fix/401-storm-1.","After the fix, the flaky test in tests/auth/test_token_refresh.py improved from 82 failures per hundred runs to zero.","The issue was discovered and fixed on 2026-01-12 in the Python authentication service component."]}
